first_visit: You will likely need your USC ID.
There is likely a short safety orientation before you first use the tools.
Ask staff which training your tool needs; it typically differs by tool.
estimates.training_note: Cutting, power and machine tools likely need an orientation plus training on that tool. Ask staff before you plan around one.
estimates.cost_note: You likely pay for materials only. Where this space lists no price, cost ranges use the Baum Family Maker Space's prices as typical campus prices.
